program.name: Lift & Lengthen
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: Straight-set or superset strength, then a long flexibility flow for the muscles you just trained.
program.about: Strength first, then a flexibility flow for the muscles you just worked. Upper days end on chest and shoulders, lower days on hamstrings, hips and quads, and the full-body day on a stretch from feet to neck. The lifting is straight sets and supersets with dumbbells, a kettlebell and the bar. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, while every hold in the flow gets a little longer. Good if you lift and never stretch.
program.split: Upper / lower / full body, each with a stretch
program.gear: A sturdy chair or couch for step-ups and hip thrusts.
